intro.title: 考研英语二 · 作文模板库
intro.desc: 大作文（图表作文）与小作文通用模板。先认占位符，再按「认图 → 数事物 → 挑走势」三步选句：骨架句给结构，功能句池给变化——不要整段硬套，按提示挑句拼装。
rules: 认图：柱状 bar chart / 饼图 pie chart / 折线 line chart / 表格 table——图表类型决定首句怎么写
数事物：1 个用单句；2 个用对比句（while / By contrast）；3 个以上先分组再写（最大 / 中间两个 / 其余）
挑走势动词：上升 rose / climbed；下降 fell / declined；一升一降才用 By contrast；平稳用 held steady / plateaued
第二段（原因）：骨架句 + 句池挑 1~2 句 ≈ 55~65 词，尽量留一句回扣图表数字
第三段（建议）：正面或负面选一版，骨架句 + 句池挑 1~2 句 ≈ 50~60 词
字数核算：三段合计 150~180 词最稳（考研要求 150+）。宁可少写一句，也不要超
placeholders: 这一题的题相关词（题眼）
图里要对比的第 1/2/3…个事物
数值区间（讲波动幅度时用）
bar chart / pie chart / line chart
中文行里图表类型的泛称
该图表的类型（柱状 / 饼）

chart_guide.title: 图表适配表（2007–2026 英语二大作文）
chart_guide.desc: 先认图表：动态图（有时间变化）用动态第一段；静态图（只比占比）用静态第一段。下表不按年份排列，而是按「动态 / 静态 → 走势特征」分组：同一组的年份可直接套同一组功能句，只需换关键词与数据。

decisions.v: 只写两句：一句给数值，一句给走势（From…to…, rose from…to…）。不要硬凑对比句。
用对比结构：同向且速度不同 → While B rose slowly, A climbed sharply；一升一降 → A climbed…, while B fell…，后半句才用 By contrast。
先分组再写：最大项 takes the largest share at…，中间两个 come next at… and…，其余 account for only…。不要平铺五个数字。

decisions.k: 走势 = 都升（速度不同）
decisions.v: 两事物各用 rose / climbed，用 while 并列，收尾用 Both moved in the same direction, but at very different speeds。
升用 rose / climbed，降用 fell / declined，衔接用 while 或 By contrast。切勿把下降写成上升。
一句数值 + 一句走势：more than doubled（翻倍）/ held steady（平稳）/ moved within a narrow range（窄幅波动）。

sections.group: 大作文 · 第一段（图表描述）
sections.title: 静态图表第一段
sections.subtitle: 适用：饼图 / 柱状图中各类别的占比分布（只比比例，没有时间变化）
sections.en: The {{chart}} chart shows how {{topic}} is distributed among the categories. {{item1}} takes the largest share, at {{percent1}}. {{item2}} and {{item3}} come next, at {{percent2}} and {{percent3}}. By contrast, {{item4}} and {{item5}} account for only {{percent4}} and {{percent5}}.
sections.cn: 该 {{chart}} 图显示 {{topic}} 在各类别之间的分布情况。{{item1}} 占比最高，为 {{percent1}}。其次是 {{item2}} 和 {{item3}}，分别为 {{percent2}} 和 {{percent3}}。相比之下，{{item4}} 和 {{item5}} 仅占 {{percent4}} 和 {{percent5}}。
sections.note: {{chart}} 处按图型填 pie / bar / line；句池里挑 1~2 句替换骨架后半段，控制字数，不必全写。

sentences.en: {{item1}} alone accounts for {{percent1}} of the total.
sentences.cn: {{item1}} 一项就占了总量的 {{percent1}}。

sentences.en: The top three categories — {{item1}}, {{item2}} and {{item3}} — make up {{percent1}}, {{percent2}} and {{percent3}}.
sentences.cn: 排名前三的类别——{{item1}}、{{item2}} 和 {{item3}}——分别占 {{percent1}}、{{percent2}} 和 {{percent3}}。

sentences.en: Only {{percent4}} goes to {{item4}}, and {{item5}} is even lower.
sentences.cn: {{item4}} 只占 {{percent4}}，{{item5}} 更低。

sentences.en: In other words, the first two categories take up more than half of {{topic}}.
sentences.cn: 换句话说，前两类占了 {{topic}} 的一半以上。

sentences.en: A closer look shows that the four smaller categories are fairly evenly matched.
sentences.cn: 再仔细看，其余四个类别的占比其实相差不大。

sentences.en: While {{item1}} dominates the chart, the remaining categories are spread rather evenly.
sentences.cn: 虽然 {{item1}} 在图中占主导，其余类别的分布却比较平均。

sentences.en: This distribution suggests that {{topic}} is still concentrated in a few categories.
sentences.cn: 这种分布说明 {{topic}} 仍然集中在少数几类上。

sentences.en: Taken together, the three largest categories account for {{percent total}}.
sentences.cn: 把最大的三类加在一起，共占 {{percent total}}。

tips: 静态图只比占比，别写时间——一旦出现年份，就改用动态第一段。
三个以上事物一定要先分组（最大 / 中间 / 其余），不要平铺五个数字。
en_struct: how {{topic}} is distributed among the categories

sections.group: 大作文 · 第一段（图表描述）
sections.title: 动态图表第一段
sections.subtitle: 适用：折线 / 柱状图中事物随时间变化（有起始年—终止年）
sections.en: The {{chart}} chart tracks how {{topic}} changed from {{time1}} to {{time2}}. {{item1}} climbed from {{num1}} to {{num2}}, while {{item2}} rose more slowly, from {{num3}} to {{num4}}. By contrast, {{item3}} fell from {{num5}} to {{num6}}.
sections.cn: 该 {{chart}} 图记录了 {{time1}} 到 {{time2}} 期间 {{topic}} 的变化。{{item1}} 由 {{num1}} 升至 {{num2}}，{{item2}} 上升较慢，从 {{num3}} 增至 {{num4}}。相比之下，{{item3}} 由 {{num5}} 降至 {{num6}}。
sections.note: 所有事物同向时：删掉 By contrast 那句，把 fell 改成 rose more slowly，末句加 Both moved in the same direction, but at very different speeds. 只用 2 个事物时，删去第三句。

sentences.en: From {{time1}} to {{time2}}, {{item1}} rose from {{num1}} to {{num2}}, a steady climb.
sentences.cn: 自 {{time1}} 至 {{time2}}，{{item1}} 由 {{num1}} 稳步升至 {{num2}}。

sentences.en: Over the same period, {{item2}} fell from {{num3}} to {{num4}}, a clear decline.
sentences.cn: 同一时期，{{item2}} 由 {{num3}} 降至 {{num4}}，降幅明显。

sentences.en: {{item3}} held steady at around {{num5}} after {{time1}}.
sentences.cn: {{time1}} 之后，{{item3}} 一直稳定在 {{num5}} 附近。

sentences.en: The increase in {{item1}} accelerated after {{time1}}.
sentences.cn: {{time1}} 之后，{{item1}} 的增长明显加快。

sentences.en: {{item3}} moved within a narrow range of {{num range}}, with no clear direction.
sentences.cn: {{item3}} 在 {{num range}} 这个窄区间内波动，看不出明确方向。

sentences.en: By {{time2}}, {{item1}} had more than doubled, reaching {{num2}}.
sentences.cn: 到 {{time2}} 时，{{item1}} 已经翻了一倍多，达到 {{num2}}。

sentences.en: Both moved in the same direction, but at very different speeds.
sentences.cn: 两者方向一致，但速度快慢差别很大。

sentences.en: One detail stands out: {{item1}} rose from {{num1}} to {{num2}} while {{item3}} went the other way.
sentences.cn: 有一点很突出：{{item1}} 从 {{num1}} 升到 {{num2}}，而 {{item3}} 恰恰相反。

tips: 动态图必须有时间（{{time1}} → {{time2}}）；没有时间就改用静态第一段。
同向但速度不同 → 一个 climbed + 一个 rose more slowly，用 while 并列即可，不必用 By contrast。
只有一升一降时，才用 By contrast 转折。

sections.group: 大作文 · 第二段（原因分析）
sections.title: 经济类第二段
sections.subtitle: 经济 / 消费 / 科技类：挂在收入、成本、生活方式上，最好写
sections.en: The trend in the chart is closely tied to how people live and spend today. {{item1}} rose from {{num1}} in {{time1}} to {{num2}} in {{time2}}, and that change did not happen by itself.
sections.cn: 图中的变化与人们当下的生活和消费方式密切相关。{{item1}} 从 {{time1}} 的 {{num1}} 升到 {{time2}} 的 {{num2}}，而这种变化并非凭空发生。
sections.note: 示例套用（2014 城乡人口）：骨架句写「城乡人口的变化与人们的生活选择有关」，再从句池挑「城市扩张带来需求」和「收入提高让选择变多」两句，本段约 58 词。

sentences.en: As household incomes have grown, {{topic}} has moved from a luxury to an everyday necessity.
sentences.cn: 随着家庭收入提高，{{topic}} 已从奢侈品变成日常必需品。

sentences.en: The price of {{topic}} has fallen sharply, putting it within reach of ordinary families.
sentences.cn: {{topic}} 的价格大幅下降，普通家庭也消费得起。

sentences.en: Online platforms and mobile payment have cut the time and cost of getting {{topic}}.
sentences.cn: 线上平台和移动支付降低了获得 {{topic}} 的时间和成本。

sentences.en: Cities have grown quickly, and demand for {{topic}} has grown with them.
sentences.cn: 城市快速扩张，{{topic}} 的需求也随之增长。

sentences.en: Young people are the first to try new things, and their choices soon spread.
sentences.cn: 年轻人最先尝试新事物，他们的选择很快扩散开来。

sentences.en: Government support — from tax breaks to better infrastructure — has also helped.
sentences.cn: 政府支持——从税收优惠到基础设施改善——也起了作用。

sentences.en: Once {{item1}} reached {{num2}}, growth became hard to stop.
sentences.cn: {{item1}} 一旦达到 {{num2}}，增长就很难再停下来。

sentences.en: More importantly, {{topic}} now serves a practical need rather than a passing fashion.
sentences.cn: 更重要的是，{{topic}} 现在满足的是实际需要，而不是一时风尚。

en_struct: how people live and spend today
, and that change did not happen by itself
phrases: moved from a luxury to an everyday necessity
从奢侈品变成日常必需品
cut the time and cost of
tips: 骨架句 33 词 + 句池挑 1~2 句 ≈ 55~65 词，第二段到此为止，不要贪多。
留一句回扣图表数字（第 7 句那种），阅卷人一眼就能看到你用了图里的数据。

sections.group: 大作文 · 第二段（原因分析）
sections.title: 校园类第二段（对应英语一品质类）
sections.subtitle: 校园 / 品质类（对应英语一品质题）：含正面、负面两版，改几个词即可切换
sections.en: Behind the numbers in the chart lies a change in how students spend their time. Habits built at this stage shape how young people take responsibility later. {{topic}} is one of the clearest examples.
sections.cn: 数字背后，是学生时间安排方式的变化。这个阶段养成的习惯，会影响他们日后承担责任的方式。{{topic}} 就是最清楚的例子之一。
sections.negative_en: Behind the numbers in the chart lies a problem that deserves attention. Habits formed at this stage are hard to change later, and the wrong ones carry a lasting cost. {{topic}} shows how easily that cost can build up.
sections.negative_cn: 数字背后，是一个值得注意的问题。这个阶段形成的习惯日后很难改变，而不良习惯的代价会长期存在。{{topic}} 正说明这种代价有多容易累积。
en_struct: Behind the numbers in the chart
a change in how students spend their time
how young people take responsibility later
phrases: Behind the numbers in the chart lies …
shape the way sb do sth
negative_struct: Behind the numbers in the chart
, and the wrong ones carry a lasting cost
how easily that cost can build up
tips: 骨架句 37 词 + 句池挑 1~2 句 ≈ 55~65 词；正面、负面两版骨架只差几个词，改词即可切换，不必另背一段。
这一段最容易写空，尽量用一句具体场景（如「合作」那句）替代抽象概括。

sentences.en: {{topic}} teaches students to plan their own time rather than wait to be told.
sentences.cn: {{topic}} 让学生学会自己安排时间，而不是等人安排。

sentences.en: It also builds the habit of finishing what has been started, even when it is boring.
sentences.cn: 它还能养成有始有终的习惯，哪怕过程枯燥。

sentences.en: Students who take part in {{topic}} often work better with others.
sentences.cn: 参与 {{topic}} 的学生通常更善于与人合作。

sentences.en: The skills involved — patience, self-control, persistence — matter long after school ends.
sentences.cn: 其中的耐心、自控和坚持，在离开学校很久之后仍然有用。

sentences.en: On the other hand, too much of it can crowd out sleep and real conversation.
sentences.cn: 另一方面，过度投入会挤占睡眠和真实交流的时间。

sentences.en: Without guidance, students may copy what their peers do instead of deciding for themselves.
sentences.cn: 缺少引导时，学生容易跟着同伴走，而不是自己判断。

sentences.en: That is why schools and parents both have a part to play.
sentences.cn: 所以学校和家长都需要参与。

sentences.en: Used well, {{topic}} is training for adult life rather than a way to fill time.
sentences.cn: 用得好的话，{{topic}} 是为成年生活做准备，而不是打发时间。

sections.group: 大作文 · 第二段（原因分析）
sections.title: 环境生态类第二段
sections.subtitle: 环境生态类：挂在意识提升 + 条件改善上
sections.en: The change in the chart has been building for years. People today are far more aware of environmental problems than they were in {{time1}}, and {{topic}} is what that awareness has produced.
sections.cn: 图中的变化已经积累了很多年。如今人们对环境问题的认识比 {{time1}} 时清楚得多，{{topic}} 正是这种认识带来的结果。
en_struct: , and {{topic}} is what that awareness has produced
tips: 环境类最忌只喊口号（「保护环境很重要」），尽量写具体做法。
这一段的写法与体育健康类通用，换几个词即可。

sentences.en: Air and water quality have visibly improved in many cities, so green habits no longer seem pointless.
sentences.cn: 许多城市的空气和水质明显好转，环保习惯不再显得没有意义。

sentences.en: Sorted bins, electric buses and public parks have made green choices easier to make.
sentences.cn: 分类垃圾桶、电动公交和城市公园让环保选择更容易实现。

sentences.en: Schools now teach children about the environment, and those children bring the habit home.
sentences.cn: 学校开始教孩子环保知识，孩子又把习惯带回家里。

sentences.en: New technologies have cut the cost of clean energy and recycled products.
sentences.cn: 新技术降低了清洁能源和再生产品的成本。

sentences.en: Government rules have pushed companies to clean up their production.
sentences.cn: 政府的法规推动企业减少生产中的污染。

sentences.en: Once green choices are convenient, more people are willing to change their routines.
sentences.cn: 环保选择一旦变得方便，愿意改变日常习惯的人就多了。

sentences.en: The figure for {{item1}} going from {{num1}} to {{num2}} is only the visible part of that shift.
sentences.cn: {{item1}} 从 {{num1}} 到 {{num2}}，只是这场变化里看得见的那部分。

sentences.en: In short, the numbers reflect habits that have already taken root.
sentences.cn: 总之，这些数字反映的是已经扎下根的习惯。

sections.group: 大作文 · 第二段（原因分析）
sections.title: 体育健康类第二段
sections.subtitle: 体育健康类：挂在久坐、健康支出和观念变化上（与环保类思路不同，别混用）
sections.en: The figures are less about sport itself than about how people now look after themselves. Long working hours have turned health into something to plan for, and {{topic}} is the easiest way to do that.
sections.cn: 这些数字与其说关于运动本身，不如说反映了人们现在如何照顾自己。长时间工作让健康变成需要主动安排的事，而 {{topic}} 是最容易做到的一种方式。
en_struct: than about how people now look after themselves
, and {{topic}} is the easiest way to do that
phrases: 与其说关于…不如说关于…
a practical need rather than a hobby
tips: 这一段的骨架句和环保类完全不同（环保讲意识与条件，体育讲久坐、支出与观念），不要混用。
写完原因后留一句回扣数据（第 6 句那种），避免全段空谈。

sentences.en: Sitting all day has turned exercise into a practical need rather than a hobby.
sentences.cn: 整天坐着，让运动从爱好变成了实际需要。

sentences.en: Fitness apps and smart watches let people track their progress and stay motivated.
sentences.cn: 健身 App 和智能手表让人能记录进展、保持动力。

sentences.en: Gyms, running tracks and community courts are now common even in smaller cities.
sentences.cn: 现在连中小城市也常见健身房、跑道和社区球场。

sentences.en: Health campaigns have reminded the public that prevention is cheaper than treatment.
sentences.cn: 健康宣传提醒公众：预防比治疗便宜。

sentences.en: People with higher incomes spend more on keeping fit, and the gap is widening.
sentences.cn: 收入较高的人更愿意为健身花钱，而且这个差距在扩大。

sentences.en: From {{time1}} to {{time2}}, {{item1}} rose from {{num1}} to {{num2}}, which fits the wider pattern.
sentences.cn: 从 {{time1}} 到 {{time2}}，{{item1}} 由 {{num1}} 升至 {{num2}}，与整体趋势一致。

sentences.en: The rise is not only about money: attitudes to health have changed.
sentences.cn: 这一增长不只因为钱：人们对健康的态度也变了。

sentences.en: In short, exercising has moved from a personal choice to a social habit.
sentences.cn: 总之，运动已经从个人选择变成了社会习惯。

sections.group: 大作文 · 第二段（原因分析）
sections.title: 文化自信类第二段
sections.subtitle: 文化自信类：核心逻辑是「传统 + 现代表达」
sections.en: Traditional culture does not survive by being preserved in a museum. It survives when people find new ways to pass it on. The growth shown in the chart is that process at work.
sections.cn: 传统文化不是靠放进博物馆保存下来的。它靠的是人们不断找到新的传递方式。图中的增长，正是这一过程在起作用。
en_struct: when people find new ways to pass it on
The growth shown in the chart
phrases: find new ways to pass it on
is being used rather than only admired
在被使用而不只是被欣赏
tips: 文化类最容易写成口号，尽量落到具体做法（纪录片、展览、课程、文创）。
「传统 + 现代表达」是这一段的通用逻辑，换题只需换载体。

sentences.en: {{topic}} brings traditional culture closer to ordinary life instead of leaving it on the shelf.
sentences.cn: {{topic}} 把传统文化拉近日常生活，而不是把它束之高阁。

sentences.en: Documentaries and short videos have made old stories interesting to young audiences.
sentences.cn: 纪录片和短视频让老故事对年轻观众有了吸引力。

sentences.en: Museums now design exhibitions that visitors can take part in, not just look at.
sentences.cn: 博物馆现在设计的展览，观众能参与而不只是观看。

sentences.en: Schools have added courses on local history and traditional crafts.
sentences.cn: 学校增加了地方历史和传统手工艺课程。

sentences.en: Commercial products carry cultural elements into daily use, from clothing to household goods.
sentences.cn: 从服装到家居用品，文创产品把文化元素带进了日常使用。

sentences.en: The rise in {{item1}}, from {{num1}} to {{num2}}, shows how quickly public interest can grow.
sentences.cn: {{item1}} 从 {{num1}} 升到 {{num2}}，说明公众兴趣可以增长得多快。

sentences.en: Cultural confidence grows when tradition is lived, not merely recited.
sentences.cn: 传统被真正用起来、而不只是背诵时，文化自信才会增长。

sentences.en: In short, the chart records a culture that is being used rather than only admired.
sentences.cn: 总之，图表记录的是一种正在被使用、而不只是被欣赏的文化。

sections.group: 大作文 · 第三段（总结建议）
sections.title: 第三段 · 正面版
sections.subtitle: 第三段 · 正面版：主体按题挑（政府 / 学校 / 家庭 / 企业平台 / 媒体 / 个人 各 2 句）
sections.en: If the trend in the chart is to continue, more than one side has to act. Each of them has a different job to do, and none can do it alone.
sections.cn: 图中的趋势若要延续，就需要多方一起行动。各方要做的事不同，单靠任何一方都做不到。
en_struct: If the trend in the chart is to continue
, and none can do it alone
phrases: more than one side has to act
has a different job to do
is not limited to those who can pay
不只属于付得起钱的人
tips: 骨架句 29 词 + 挑 2 句主体句 ≈ 50~60 词，第三段不要写长。
先看题目问的是谁的事：学校的事就写学校 + 家庭，社会风气就写媒体 + 个人，别一律写政府。

sentences.en: Government can fund public facilities so that {{topic}} is not limited to those who can pay.
sentences.cn: 政府可以投入公共设施，让 {{topic}} 不只属于付得起钱的人。

sentences.en: Clear rules and steady funding matter more than one-off campaigns.
sentences.cn: 明确的规则和持续的投入，比一次性活动更重要。

sentences.en: Schools can build {{topic}} into daily routines instead of treating it as an extra.
sentences.cn: 学校可以把 {{topic}} 纳入日常安排，而不是当成额外任务。

sentences.en: Courses and after-class activities give students a chance to try {{topic}} for themselves.
sentences.cn: 课程和课外活动让学生有机会亲自体验 {{topic}}。

sentences.en: Families matter most: children copy what adults do far more than what they are told.
sentences.cn: 家庭最关键：孩子模仿大人怎么做，远多于听大人怎么说。

sentences.en: Parents can set the tone by making {{topic}} part of ordinary family life.
sentences.cn: 父母可以把 {{topic}} 变成家庭日常的一部分，从而带动全家人。

sentences.en: Companies can make {{topic}} cheaper and easier to use, so that it reaches more people.
sentences.cn: 企业可以把 {{topic}} 做得更便宜、更好用，让它覆盖更多人。

sentences.en: Platforms should design simple, honest interfaces instead of ones that keep users hooked.
sentences.cn: 平台应把界面做得简单诚实，而不是想方设法让人上瘾。

sentences.en: Media should report on {{topic}} honestly, without exaggerating its benefits or its risks.
sentences.cn: 媒体应如实报道 {{topic}}，既不夸大好处，也不夸大风险。

sentences.en: Documentaries and short videos can show how {{topic}} works in real life.
sentences.cn: 纪录片和短视频能让人看到 {{topic}} 在现实中是怎样运作的。

sentences.en: Individuals should choose what fits their own situation rather than follow the crowd.
sentences.cn: 个人应按自身情况选择，而不是随大流。

sentences.en: Small habits matter: a little {{topic}} every day adds up over a year.
sentences.cn: 小习惯很重要：每天一点 {{topic}}，一年下来就不一样。

sections.group: 大作文 · 第三段（总结建议）
sections.title: 第三段 · 负面版
sections.subtitle: 第三段 · 负面版：同样按主体挑（政府 / 学校 / 家庭 / 企业平台 / 媒体 / 个人 各 2 句）
sections.en: If nothing is done, the problem shown in the chart will only get worse. Any serious response has to come from several directions at once.
sections.cn: 如果什么都不做，图中的问题只会更严重。任何认真的应对，都需要多个方向同时发力。
en_struct: , the problem shown in the chart
phrases: rather than treat them as scare stories
而不是当成吓人的故事
makes the public numb instead of alert
tips: 不要写成「我们要重视」，要写清谁做什么——这正是第三段最容易露怯的地方。
挑 2 个主体即可；题目涉及青少年就优先学校 + 家庭。

sentences.en: Authorities should set clear limits and make sure they are actually enforced.
sentences.cn: 政府应设定明确的上限，并确保真正执行。

sentences.en: Penalties need to be heavy enough to matter.
sentences.cn: 处罚要重到真正起作用。

sentences.en: Schools and families should warn young people before the habit takes hold.
sentences.cn: 学校和家庭应在习惯养成之前提醒年轻人。

sentences.en: Classes on {{topic}} can help students tell safe use from misuse.
sentences.cn: 关于 {{topic}} 的课程能帮学生分清正常使用和滥用。

sentences.en: Parents who ignore their own habits cannot expect children to do better.
sentences.cn: 父母自己不注意，就别指望孩子做得好。

sentences.en: A stable routine at home leaves less room for the problem to grow.
sentences.cn: 家里作息稳定，问题就不容易滋生。

sentences.en: Platforms should label or restrict content that encourages misuse.
sentences.cn: 平台应对诱导滥用的内容加以标注或限制。

sentences.en: Companies should not profit from designs that keep users hooked.
sentences.cn: 企业不应靠让人上瘾的设计赚钱。

sentences.en: Media should report the real risks rather than treat them as scare stories.
sentences.cn: 媒体应报道真实风险，而不是把它当成吓人的故事。

sentences.en: Sensational coverage makes the public numb instead of alert.
sentences.cn: 耸动的报道让公众变得麻木，而不是警觉。

sentences.en: Individuals need to watch their own habits instead of assuming they are safe.
sentences.cn: 个人需要留意自己的习惯，而不是想当然地认为没问题。

sentences.en: Keeping a simple record of daily use is often enough to spot the problem early.
sentences.cn: 简单记录一下每天的使用情况，往往就能及早发现问题。

sections.note: 负面版与正面版结构相同，主体同样按题挑（政府 / 学校 / 家庭 / 企业平台 / 媒体 / 个人），改词即可切换。
